newsitem.title: UK: CADES plans $1.0 billion five-year Eurobond.
newsitem.headline: CADES plans $1.0 billion five-year Eurobond.

text.p: Caisse d'amortissement de la dette sociale (CADES) plans to launch a $1.0 billion five-year Eurobond, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell said on Monday.
Deutsche Morgan Grenfell said the deal would be launched on Tuesday March 4, subject to market conditions.
Goldman Sachs will be joint lead manager for the transaction.
CADES has issued several jumbo bonds in the international bond market since being set up early in 1996 to pay off French social security debt.
CADES last tapped the dollar sector in early December with a debut dollar offering -- a $2.0 billion December 2001 FRN -- via joint lead managers BZW and J.P. Morgan.
